headline: GIFT Nifty signals weak start; NSE shares debut today amid falling crude oil prices and rising dollar

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: GIFT Nifty indicates a negative opening for Indian markets, trading down by over 100 points
The US Dollar reached a two-month high, fueling inflation fears and expectations of further Fed rate hikes
Crude oil prices fell to $102 as Iran signaled openness to diplomacy, easing some energy cost concerns
Global bond selloffs and mixed performance in Asian markets are weighing on investor sentiment
whatHappening: National Stock Exchange (NSE) shares are set to make their highly anticipated market debut today
Grey Market Premium (GMP) for NSE shares suggests a potential listing gain of approximately 2%
Twelve stocks are in focus after showing a positive breakout by crossing above their 200-day moving averages
India's Company Law Tribunal is reportedly facing a crisis, impacting corporate legal proceedings
summary: Indian indices are set for a weak opening as GIFT Nifty signals a decline of over 100 points amid a global bond selloff. The primary focus today is the market debut of NSE shares, which are expected to list at a slight premium based on grey market trends. Investors are also monitoring falling crude oil prices and a strengthening US Dollar for further market direction.
